chunks: And ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Qays, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said: Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said:

Indeed, the debt comes before the will, then the will follows after the debt, then the inheritance comes after the will. For the foremost matter to be fulfilled is the Book of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.الدَّيْنَ: Debt owed by the deceased that must be paid first from the estate.
key_terms.الْقَضَاءِ: Fulfillment or execution of what is due and legally binding.
key_terms.الْمِيرَاثَ: The inherited estate distributed to the legal heirs after debt and will.
key_terms.الْوَصِيَّةِ: The bequest or will to be carried out after debts are settled.
key_terms.كِتَابُ اللَّهِ: The divine scripture as the highest legal authority in this ruling.

ai.seo_question: In what order are debt, will, and inheritance handled in a deceased person's estate according to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith sets the legal order for distributing a deceased person's estate: debts are settled first, then the will is executed, and only after that is the inheritance distributed. It emphasizes that this priority is grounded in the Book of Allah, underscoring the binding authority of divine legal prescription in matters of estate and financial rights.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5438 - Aṣim ibn Humayd narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said that the Commander of the Faithful (as) said:

"Indeed, the debt takes precedence over the will, then the will follows after the debt, and then the inheritance comes after the will. Verily, fulfilling what is prescribed in the Book of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, has the highest priority."
